summary: Angel Oak Mortgage REIT filed an 8-K regarding a stock repurchase agreement with Xylem Finance LLC, an affiliate of Davidson Kempner, to buy back $15.0 million of common stock at a 3% discount to VWAP. The repurchase is conditioned on director Vikram Shankar's resignation effective at closing, which also terminates a shareholder rights agreement. No board recommendation or advisor named. Structurally, this is a negotiated exit with a board seat change. Watch for closing mechanics and whether the discount signals further alignment or governance shifts.
